name: aspire-atlas
description: Claude plugins for the Aspire Atlas platform (atlas.aspire.io): onboarding, first insights, creator briefs and discovery, content review, competitive signal, and scheduled daily and weekly insights reports.

plugins.name: aspire
plugins.description: Aspire Atlas is the Creative Intelligence layer for your brand's social content. Connect Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube for social listening, competitive benchmarking, and brand safety checks. Discover creators, plan next week's content, review posts before they go live, and get daily and weekly reports in Slack or email. Type /aspire to start.

plugins.name: aspire-mod
plugins.description: Optional add-on for the Aspire Atlas plugin: a progress bar and band above the prompt and an agents panel while /aspire runs, display only. Install it alongside the aspire plugin; it stays inert until /aspire runs.
